purpose: Categories Kindle-1 may choose from. Kindle-1 must choose two categories per topic from this list only. Changes need the owner's approval.
how_ranked: Evidence strength (estimated, not sales data: Amazon publishes no sales by category) combined with fit to the guide's formats. Health, finance, legal and medical categories are excluded by the guide.
sources: https://www.inkfluenceai.com/best-ebook-niches (vendor data: share of 61,879 non-fiction books, not sales)
caveat: Every category path must be checked in the KDP category picker before upload. Paths marked 'Confirm' were not verified.

categories.category: Kindle Store > Kindle eBooks > Romance > Contemporary > Small Town
categories.evidence: Romance is the top-grossing fiction genre (source: selfpublishing.com, 2026, estimate); Small Town is a high-traffic romance subcategory.

categories.category: Kindle Store > Kindle eBooks > Romance > Contemporary > Romantic Comedy
